extraction.name: RoboFAC dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale and diverse dataset of robotic failures comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Simulation data was collected for 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment, augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR. Real-world data was collected for 6 tasks via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm. Each video is accompanied by a corresponding textual description.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Simulation data from the ManiSkill environment, YCB Object Dataset, ReplicaCAD, and AI2-THOR. Real-world data collected via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: To generate failure data in simulation, the original expert policy was replaced with a code snippet that generates an erroneous trajectory at a selected substage, causing the overall robotic task to fail. For failures caused by perturbations in the end-effector pose, the perturbed pose was recorded.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Given the motion planning for the robotic arm occasionally failed, resulting in trajectories that did not align with the corresponding textual descriptions, manual thorough data cleaning was performed, retaining approximately 75% of the collected data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For each sample, reference answers were generated based on the textual description associated with the video. For five question types, answers were directly extracted from the textual description. For the remaining three types (failure explanation, high-level correction, low-level correction), the video and textual description were used as inputs to GPT-4o to generate reference answers. All outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The current integration of the model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless. The model is exclusively applied to the VLA model in this work, lacking targeted correction strategies for hierarchical policies.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation. Used to train and evaluate multimodal models for robotic task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction.
